tools.description: Issue a Warrant (mandate) for a Rider identity. Pass rider JWT, or demo:true for a 10-minute shape check. Complements Agent-Rider.

tools.description: Verify a Warrant token. Optional host, action, and expected usd cost — pass usd to enforce the spend cap BEFORE the job runs.

tools.description: Reserve the expected cost against a Warrant BEFORE the job runs (pre-spend cap enforcement). File the receipt with the reservation id to settle without double-deducting, or release it if the job never runs.

tools.name: spl_warrant_release
tools.description: Refund an unsettled Warrant reservation (job never ran).

tools.name: spl_warrant_receipt
tools.description: File a receipt against a Warrant after an action.

tools.name: spl_agentic_run
tools.description: Run one ACN (Agent Commerce Network) run. Needs confirm:true plus demo:true or a rider+warrant pair. Unpaid steps answer 402.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: cuni_bank, spl_warrant_issue · Private data: spl_lab_auth, spl_signup, spl_agent_key, spl_zip, spl_unzip, spl_warrant_verify, spl_warrant_reserve, spl_warrant_receipt, spl_agentic_plan · Public sink: spl_signup · Destructive: spl_agentic_plan, spl_agentic_run.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: cuni_bank, spl_warrant_issue · Private data: spl_lab_auth, spl_signup, spl_agent_key, spl_zip, spl_unzip, spl_warrant_verify, spl_warrant_reserve, spl_warrant_receipt, spl_agentic_plan · Public sink: spl_signup · Destructive: spl_agentic_plan, spl_agentic_run

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "spl_quote" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Suite quote. First 1 GB/month free, then $0.25/GB of input, $1 card minimum. Args: bytes, product, op." → after: "Suite quote. First 1 GB free once per IP, then $0.25/GB of input, $1 card minimum. Args: bytes, product, op."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
